description: Finds free guided audio practices from The Holistic Care's Stillness Library (short guided meditations, breathing practices, and Yoga Nidra sessions) — e.g. 'a free practice for someone upset after an argument' or 'a short breathing practice for children'. Every result returned by this tool is free; paid Stillness Library tracks are never exposed through the public API this server relies on. There is no audience metadata on practices — use category: 'children' for child-appropriate practices, and treat other audience assumptions as unsupported rather than inferred.
name: find_guided_practices
title: Find free guided practices
